g.text: Yernur Kenzhegazin · Alan Berdigaliyev · Hugo Telles
M2 GENIOMHE-AI | Supervisor: Amaury Giard, IBISC
Bulk LINCS L1000 + independent GEO studies

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: We test whether molecular structure adds predictive

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 19px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f7a

g.text: Published sci-Plex3/A549 results; separate from our data.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Three MLPs share controls, hidden layers and targets;
the chemical representation and input width can differ.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 27px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #2878a5
font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #2878a5

font-weight: 600; font-size: 28px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #be6c37

g.text: PRnet adds Gaussian noise. All predict 978 treated genes.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Validation NLL selects settings and checkpoints

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #22272d
font-weight: 600; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #22272d

g.text: Schematic: rows = cell lines; columns = compounds.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: A | Simple baselines remain stronger than the chemical networks
Equal tuning budget · three seeds · low-similarity test: 474 compounds / 16,531 profiles
Circles: training seeds; diamonds: mean; lines: seed range. Dashed lines: unchanged controls.
Left: nearest training ECFP4 similarity ≤0.7. Right: 574 profiles / 137 compounds. Lower MSE is better.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Positive values show a shuffling penalty. Input dependence
is distinct from beating a trained control-only model.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: C | Control-only leads this small panel
10 µM · 24 h · correct directions out of six genes
Seven studies; each value averages three training seeds.
Only 15 of 42 labels meet the clear-change sensitivity rule.

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 29px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #ffffff

g.text: CONCLUSION | Chemical dependence alone does not establish useful drug ranking
The molecular MLPs have lower MSE than PRnet, but simple baselines remain stronger on average.
External direction differences remain uncertain. Reused test sets make this evidence exploratory.
Wei et al., Nat Methods (2026) · doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02980-0 · Published inset: Fig. 5e, right
Project panels A–C: bulk LINCS / GEO · Full methods, noise tests and uncertainty in the report and notebook
